_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. Read live at 09:42 ET from the broker: the 99.94 that the 00:53 read showed unsettled has settled, so deployable is now the full balance rather than the 28.96 the board carried overnight. The board's old split was not wrong, it was pre-settlement; the brokerage figure is the one reconciled to.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Resolved against. The open settled the question the 00:53 read could not: AMD is bid 491.73 against a 518.58 official close, about -5.2%. The after-hours 478.41 bid was directionally right. A continuation setup needs a strong reaction to continue and the reaction was negative, so this is not a pullback to buy - it is the gap-down branch, which the rulebook answers with stand aside. Bouncing off the low is not reclaiming the close.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Conditional on a strong leader, and the leader printed red. There is no upside chain to find a laggard in. SMCI, the name this read pointed at, is bid 31.38 and down about 1.0% - it is not lagging a move, it is following the same one down.

entryWatch.trigger: A pullback that holds on 8/6 or 8/7, not today's reaction bar
entryWatch.why: The one live catalyst on the list, and the one entry the rulebook explicitly forbids today. UPST reported 8/4 after the bell and is bid 32.23 against a 30.32 close, about +6.3%. That is the reaction day itself, which checklist item 2 calls a wait signal. Worth noting against it as well: the after-hours bid was 33.81 and the open is 32.23, so the move is fading rather than extending. The setup that fits is the day-2/3 pullback, which by definition cannot be bought today.

entryWatch.trigger: Leader gapped down, most of the list red, only catalyst is a reaction-day spike
entryWatch.why: This is the branch the open resolved to and it is the position the account is in. Seven of the nine candidates are red, the eighth is a print-day spike the checklist forbids chasing, and four of the nine report tonight. A one-position account has no way to be wrong cheaply here. Deployable cash keeps for a setup that fits.
